posts.title: Is there life outside of git?
posts.description: Is There Life Outside of Git? Yes. Much more than you think. Google, Meta, and (as of October 2026) Anthropic roll their own in-house version control . Why? Because of scale, mainly. There are so many version control systems, many of which we won’t be dealing with here (looking at you Mercurial), that JJ was born. A brand new VCS which uses git as its storage layer. JJ is built from the ground up

posts.title: Encoding for the 21st century
posts.description: Encoding for the 21st century In the last few days I have been moving pictures and music to my self-hosted setup . How do I compress my files so to get as much quality as possible without breaking the bank on storage? Encode pictures with JPEGXL and music with Opus.
